measurementContract.canonicalBoundary: fresh-process-first-analysis: new Deno child per sample; one Compiler.create() (createMs) + one analyzeSource(path, source) (analyzeMs); source read outside call clock (readMs) inside operational total; no priming (no portableGraph/prepare/checkSource before the canonical call)
measurementContract.operationalBoundary: spawn-through-exit wall per sample (wallMs, measured by run.ts) plus in-child operational total
measurementContract.deferredBoundaries: fresh session in existing process (diagnostic only), resident unchanged/edited, prepare/compile splits: harness supports them via later sample.ts modes; not measured in A1
measurementContract.batchPlan: 3 independent runs x >=15 fresh-process samples per fixture; rotate fixture order per run; no CPU contention; report every duration + per-run/aggregate median, MAD, sample-limited p95; no index pairing, no discarding startups; noise rules per spec/COST_MODEL.md
measurementContract.provenanceRule: run.ts captures the measured input closure (commit, scoped host bytes, deno executable, fixtures, harness, compiler artifact/manifest/prelude) before the first and after the last sample; closure drift rejects the batch. Raw git worktree status is recorded before/after but does not gate (adaptation for the shared checkout; ambient drift cannot affect measurement). Full-batch agent should additionally require a quiet, clean tree.
